description:
A beautiful aerial video dedicate to the most amazing city - Shanghai City, featuring People Square, Yan'an Elevated Road, Huaihai Middle Road, The Bund and Lujiazui (Oriental Pearl, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and Shanghai Tower)
Edited: Ye Jun
DJI Mavic Mini 2.7K/30fps
2020.03.04
